description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

Shared Platforms builds the technology that CX and Global Financial Crimes Operations run on, and we are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own workforce management. You will own one real-time system for demand and capacity across agentic and human workforces, so the business can optimize for cost and quality as conditions change. You will partner closely with Operations leadership on where to invest and how to land change, and you will carry the roadmap from problem framing through adoption.

What you'll do:

  • Own the multi-year workforce management roadmap, with one trusted view of cost, quality, and partner performanceTurn operational processes into product requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes, and build the loops that correct drift in forecasts, schedules, and quality scoring.
  • Automate partner billing end to end, from governed source data to a monthly close that Finance and Operations can both audit.
  • Partner with Engineering on architecture, data quality, and reliability, and own the path to launch through phased rollout, monitoring, and named support owners.
  • Decide where automation and AI earn their place, including evaluation before scale, human review, auditability, and fallback.
  • Manage third-party vendor relationships across evaluation, statements of work, service levels, renewals, and escalations.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including ownership of an internal or enterprise platform used by Operations teams.
  • A track record shipping complex, cross-functional operational products end to end, from framing the problem through adoption and measurable adoption gains.
  • Experience making buy-versus-build decisions on systems of real consequence, weighing total cost, integration effort, and exit risk.
  • Fluency with data: defining baselines, instrumenting adoption, and challenging a forecast or savings estimate that does not hold up.
  • Experience owning workforce management, quality management, or billing systems in a regulated environment with privacy, audit, and oversight requirements.
  • Proven influence across Operations, Engineering, Analytics, Compliance, Finance, and Procurement without direct authority.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
  • Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

#P77114

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 

 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
$180,370—$212,175 USD
